name: contract-doc-v3
description: WordFTW: Contract Authoring Platform - Cross-platform collaborative document editing

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:collab" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:addin"
scripts.dev:server: cd server && npm ci && cross-env NODE_ENV=development node src/server.js
scripts.dev:collab: cd collab && npm ci && cross-env NODE_ENV=development node server.js
scripts.dev:addin: cd addin && npm ci && npm run dev-server
scripts.build:addin: cd addin && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm ci && cd server && npm ci && cd ../collab && npm ci && cd ../addin && npm ci
scripts.status: echo 'Checking service status...' && node -e "console.log('Services status check - use individual service commands for detailed status')"
scripts.stop: echo 'To stop services, use Ctrl+C in the terminal where they are running'
